title: Hospital HMI: Add Tote (send tote back into system via induct side)
summary: Use the Hospital HMI “Add Tote” screen to scan the tote barcode into the Tote ID and Barcode fields, verify the induct-side position information from WCS (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status), ensure the tote is positioned properly on the induct side, then press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send the tote back into the system. Use the “Remove Tote” shortcut button if you need to switch to the Remove Tote screen.
when_to_use: When a tote needs to be sent back into the OptiSweep system from the Hospital Station induct side using the Hospital HMI “Add Tote” workflow.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Hospital HMI “Add Tote” workflow (scan tote barcode, verify induct-side WCS position information, position tote on induct side, and press CONFIRM & EXECUTE).
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI access to the “Add Tote” screen
Green scanner for tote barcode scanning

system_preconditions: Hospital Station induct side has a tote positioned for re-entry (tote must be positioned properly on the induct side before CONFIRM & EXECUTE).

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI “Add Tote” screen layout and controls (Tote ID, Barcode, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, Induct Position Information panel, Remove Tote shortcut).
Hospital HMI “Remove Tote” screen (used via the Remove Tote shortcut from Add Tote).
Hospital Station layout diagram showing induct side (left side) and end stops; supports physical placement guidance (tote flush against end stops).

steps.title: Open the Hospital HMI “Add Tote” screen
steps.purpose: Access the workflow used to send a tote back into the system from the induct side.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI, open the “Add Tote” screen (Figure 4-31).
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI “Add Tote” screen is displayed with the Tote ID field, Barcode field, CONFIRM & EXECUTE button, and the Induct Position Information panel.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Add Tote” screen elements are visible and ready for scanning/confirmation (Tote ID and Barcode inputs, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, Induct Position Information panel).
steps.failure_condition: The “Add Tote” screen is not available or the required controls/panels are not displayed.

actions.label: Open Add Tote screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI “Add Tote” screen (Figure 4-31).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Add Tote” screen is used to send a tote back into the system; Figure 4-31 shows the screen and its controls.

steps.title: Scan tote barcode into the Tote ID field
steps.purpose: Populate the Tote ID field using the green scanner.
steps.instruction: In the Tote ID field, use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate the Tote ID.
steps.expected_result: The Tote ID field is populated with the scanned tote ID.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote ID field updates after scanning (non-empty value corresponding to the scanned tote barcode).
steps.failure_condition: Tote ID does not populate after scanning.

actions.label: Scan Tote ID
actions.exact_action: Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Tote ID: Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID.”

steps.title: Scan tote barcode into the Barcode field
steps.purpose: Populate the Barcode field using the green scanner.
steps.instruction: In the Barcode field, press the Barcode control, then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.
steps.expected_result: The Barcode field is populated with the scanned barcode data.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode field updates after scanning (non-empty value corresponding to the scanned tote barcode).
steps.failure_condition: Barcode field does not populate after scanning.

actions.label: Scan Barcode
actions.exact_action: Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Barcode: Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.”

steps.title: Verify induct-side position information from WCS
steps.purpose: Confirm the induct-side WCS data matches the tote being scanned/handled before sending it back into the system.
steps.instruction: Verify the “Induct Position Information” panel shows WCS data for the induct side, including AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, and Status.
steps.expected_result: Induct Position Information panel displays AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, and Status values for the induct side.
steps.healthy_condition: The Induct Position Information panel values correspond to the tote you scanned and positioned on the induct side (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status are consistent with the tote being added).
steps.failure_condition: Induct Position Information panel values do not match the tote being scanned/positioned.

actions.label: Check Induct Position Information
actions.exact_action: Verify the “Induct Position Information” panel shows WCS data for the induct side, including AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, and Status.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Induct Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status) does not match the tote being scanned/positioned, do not press CONFIRM & EXECUTE yet; re-scan Tote ID and Barcode.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Induct Position Information… This is information received from the WCS. AGV#:… Tote ID:… Barcode:… Status:…”

steps.title: Ensure tote is positioned properly on the induct side
steps.purpose: Ensure the physical tote placement matches the induct-side requirements before initiating the add action.
steps.instruction: Place the tote on the induct side and ensure it is positioned properly (flush against the end stops on the induct side).
steps.expected_result: Tote is physically positioned on the induct side in the correct location for re-entry.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote is flush against the end stops on the induct side (left side of the hospital station).
steps.failure_condition: Tote is not flush against the induct-side end stops or is positioned incorrectly.

actions.label: Verify induct-side placement
actions.exact_action: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the induct side.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “If a tote is going back into the system, put the tote on the induct side (left side) of the station. Ensure the tote is flush against the end stops.”

steps.title: Press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send tote back into the system
steps.purpose: Initiate the system action to send the tote back into the OptiSweep system from the induct side.
steps.instruction: After the tote is positioned properly on the induct side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE.
steps.expected_result: The tote is sent back into the system (initiated by the Add Tote screen). The Induct Position Information panel reflects WCS status messages for the tote/induct side (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status).
steps.healthy_condition: Induct Position Information panel shows WCS status messages consistent with the tote being processed for induct-side re-entry.
steps.failure_condition: After pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE, the tote cannot be sent back into the system.

actions.label: Confirm & Execute
actions.exact_action: After the tote is positioned properly on the induct side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send the tote back into the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tote cannot be sent back into the system after pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE, use the “Remove Tote” shortcut button to access the Remove Tote screen and follow that screen’s procedure.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Confirm & Execute Button… After the tote is positioned properly on the induct side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send the tote back into the system.”

steps.title: Use Remove Tote shortcut if needed
steps.purpose: Provide a documented fallback path to remove the tote from the system via the Remove Tote screen.
steps.instruction: If needed, use the “Remove Tote” shortcut button to navigate to the “Remove Tote” screen.
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI navigates from “Add Tote” to the “Remove Tote” screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Remove Tote screen is displayed with Tote ID, Barcode, Confirm & Execute, and Extract Position Information panel.
steps.failure_condition: The shortcut does not navigate to the Remove Tote screen.

actions.label: Open Remove Tote
actions.exact_action: Use the “Remove Tote” shortcut button to navigate to the “Remove Tote” screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “1.2 Remove Tote Button A shortcut button to the ‘Remove Tote’ screen.”
Remove Tote screen is used to remove a tote from the system; includes Tote ID, Barcode, Confirm & Execute, and Extract Position Information.

success_criteria: After pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE, the tote is sent back into the system (as initiated by the Add Tote screen).
Induct Position Information panel shows WCS status messages for the tote/induct side (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status).
healthy_conditions: Induct Position Information panel values (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status) correspond to the tote being scanned/positioned.
Tote is flush against the induct-side end stops.
After CONFIRM & EXECUTE, WCS status messages update in the Induct Position Information panel.
failure_conditions: Induct Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status) does not match the tote being scanned/positioned.
Tote cannot be sent back into the system after pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE.
escalation_guidance: If Induct Position Information does not match the tote being scanned/positioned, re-scan the tote bar code into the Tote ID and Barcode fields before pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE.
If the tote cannot be sent back into the system after pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE, use the “Remove Tote” shortcut button to access the Remove Tote screen and follow that screen’s procedure.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Add Tote screen: scan tote bar code with green scanner to populate Tote ID; press Barcode then scan with green scanner; after tote positioned properly on induct side press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send tote back into system; Induct Position Information shows WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status); Remove Tote button is a shortcut to the Remove Tote screen.
If a tote is going back into the system, put the tote on the induct side (left side) of the station; ensure the tote is flush against the end stops.
Remove Tote screen is used to remove a tote from the system; includes Tote ID, Barcode, Confirm & Execute, and Extract Position Information.
